privacy_intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data, including the use of cookies.
privacy_admin_text: The data controller is the owner of this website. If you have questions about how your data is handled, you can contact us via the contact form available on the website.
privacy_cookies_text: Our website uses cookies for functionality and traffic analysis. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.
privacy_cookie_type_necessary: Essential (technical) – required for proper site functionality (e.g., session handling, user login, abuse protection).
privacy_cookie_type_analytics: Analytics – optional cookies used to gather anonymous visit statistics (e.g., Google Analytics). These are used only with your consent.
privacy_manage_text: You can withdraw consent for analytics cookies at any time by deleting them from your browser. Here's how:
privacy_manage_chrome: In Chrome: Settings → Privacy and Security → Cookies and other site data
privacy_manage_firefox: In Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
privacy_manage_safari: In Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data
privacy_manage_private_mode: You can also use “Private” or “Incognito” mode to avoid saving cookies between sessions.
privacy_changes_text: We reserve the right to change this policy at any time. The current version will always be available on this page.

help_login_problem: Can't log in – check your username and password.
help_email_not_arrived: Didn't receive activation email – check your spam folder.
help_change_data: Want to change your data – go to your account settings after logging in.
help_send_message: How to send a message to a user – visit their profile and click "Send message".
help_contact_admin: Contacting the admins – use the contact form in the "Contact" section.
help_refresh_clear_cache: Website not working – refresh or clear your browser cache.
help_register_error: Registration error – check your form data.
help_data_secure: Is my data safe? – Yes, we use encryption and server protections.
help_report_user: Report inappropriate behavior – use the "Report" button.
